$comment: Known dependencies and the apps that need them. Data, not code: edit this file to add a dependency. Matched by winget package id first, then by a whole-word match on the app name. List an app only when its installer really expects the runtime to be present already: most current apps (Electron apps, JetBrains IDEs, the Minecraft Launcher, PowerToys) bundle their own runtime, and listing them installs runtimes nobody needs. A dependency with no apps is kept so entries added by older versions stay recognised as 'added automatically' and can be turned off.
